root_motivation: WHO: any MCP client of mcphost.dev (python `mcp` 2.1.1, the TS SDK 1.31.0, curl) and rb, the operator who reads `journalctl -u mcphost` on mcphost-1. WHAT: a client needs a refusal body it can branch on, and an operator needs one journal line per call that says which tool was called and how it ended. WHY NOT TODAY, from mcphost@7d38fd13: (1) the two body-limit sites, `refuse_unimplemented_methods` (`src/http.rs:1871-1882`) and `deliver_client_response` (`src/http.rs:1981-1998`), return `StatusCode::PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.into_response()`, a bare status with no body and no content-type, and python `mcp` 2.1.1 only parses an error body on a 4xx when `Content-Type` starts with `application/json` (`mcp/client/streamable_http.py:342-360`), so the client substitutes a stand-in that names no limit; (2) `protocol_version_and_log` (`src/http.rs:1128-1166`) logs `mcp_name` from the optional `Mcp-Name` header and the HTTP status, so a JSON-RPC refusal rides a `status=200` line and the tool name nev...
user_persona: An agent that calls host.sync.create with a source ref and gets a scheduled mirror in one call; Operator Joe who reads docs/tools.md and llms.txt and knows both were rendered from the SourceKind enum.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given the test server and no tenant key, When a tools/call of host.whoami padded inside params._meta to 1,048,577 bytes is POSTed to /mcp, Then the reply is HTTP 413, Content-Type application/json and the § 413 body, never 401 or tenant_key_missing, and the tenants row count is unchanged; the same shape at exactly 1,048,576 bytes is answered 200 and mints one tenant (row count +1); a same-size non-JSON body gets the same 413.

Given tenant A published t_ac2 and keyless B became an implicit tenant under 600 s ago, When B calls tools/call t_ac2 and a name no tenant owns, Then both -32002 bodies carry data.reason tool_not_found_on_implicit_tenant, data.tenant = B and the § Hint fields, keys a subset of the listed set, no byte of A's distinctive namespace or any key; with A's tenant_key t_ac2 succeeds; B older than 600 s gets no data.reason.

Given both body-limit sites (refuse_unimplemented_methods, deliver_client_response in src/http.rs), When either refuses, Then one shared builder writes the § 413 body: a unit test covers Some(content_length) and None, HTTP tests at refuse_unimplemented_methods cover 1,048,577 bytes with Content-Length and a chunked body (content_length null), deliver_client_response calls that builder, and drain_gate keeps its 503 JSON.

Given the error registry (src/error_registry.rs, the ERROR_CODES generator behind /errors.json and host.errors), When request_body_too_large is added, Then it is declared through err_code! with class, family and remedy so /errors.json lists it, the 413 body's data carries those fields plus request_id like every registered error, and README's request-body line names the body contract.

Given the http request line, When any /mcp POST completes, Then the line carries rpc=<method|batch|"">, tool=<tools/call name|"">, reply=ok|jsonrpc_error:<code>|http:<status>|batch by the § Reply class mechanism (response extension, line at body end), a 413 adds content_length= and limit=, and a test with one global buffered subscriber runs two concurrent calls of different reply classes and asserts each line by tool=.

Given the seven registered kinds (kinds::names()) and chain spec.steps[i], When spec or a step is not a JSON object, Then the -32602 message keeps each site's current prefix and ends with ", received <string|array|number|boolean|null>", data.received_type carries the same word, the object check runs once in the registry before any kind's validate, and one test iterates kinds::names() so a kind added later cannot skip it.

Given prod after this PRD's deploy, When the AC 7 command in § Live evidence commands runs from the build host with no credential, Then its curl line begins 413 application/json with a byte count above 0, the last line is jq_rc=0 on error_code request_body_too_large and limit_bytes 1048576, and no temp file remains (Live; evidence: AC 7 command in § Live evidence commands showing 413 application/json and jq_rc=0)
acceptance_criteria.test: deferred: Live (prod; evidence: AC 7 command in § Live evidence commands showing 413 application/json and jq_rc=0)

scope: src/sync/mod.rs: the SourceKind registry, host.sync.create/list/get/delete/run_now, and the trigger tick's sync pass writing a not_implemented sync_runs receipt.
migrations/0130_syncs.sql: syncs and sync_runs tables; Plan.syncs_max (free 5, pro 50) and the quota_syncs_max, connection_missing and schedule_too_frequent error codes.
www/llms.txt gains a generated Data sync section and docs/tools.md the source.kind enum, both rendered from SourceKind.
non_goals: Fetching rows (the pull PRD); push or conflict handling (the two-way PRD); type inference beyond text columns; any new OAuth flow.

additional.main_database_tables: syncs and sync_runs live in the main database (migration 0130), not a per-tenant file, so the tick's sync pass is one indexed query across tenants.

five_whys_trace.q: Why can an agent not keep a host table equal to a sheet?
five_whys_trace.a: No verb registers an external source; the agent would own a puller, a token and a diff loop.
host.table.append cannot update a row and host.trigger.set only calls a published tool.
One SourceKind enum generates the schema, docs and dispatch, so the five kinds cannot drift.

ambiguities_resolved.question: What is source.secret?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: The NAME of a host.secret (stored as secret_name), never a value, so no secret-named field exists on a Debug struct.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Do push and two_way modes run?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: They are accepted at create with status pending_mode (the PRD default) and the tick skips them.
